jobs.prompt:
Match the line weight, flat two-tone shading, muted palette and big-head proportions of the attached reference sheet, but draw four NEW characters from the Chinese Three Kingdoms era; do not copy the reference faces, bald heads, armor, chainmail, beards or symbols.
A 2x2 grid sheet: four equal square panels separated by thin straight black lines, laid out like the reference. Each panel has a plain flat pure white background and holds one head-and-shoulders bust: the character centered, the whole head and headgear visible with white space above and at both sides, the bust cut off by the bottom edge of its panel. Nothing in a panel touches the top or side edges of the panel.
Tone: B-movie comedy - expressions and props pushed to theatrical exaggeration.
Top-left: Guan Yu, deep red face, a long flowing black beard down to the chest that he strokes proudly with one hand, green headscarf and green robe over dark armor, calm half-closed self-satisfied eyes.
Top-right: Zhang Fei, dark ruddy face, wild spiky black beard like tiger whiskers, huge round bulging eyes, mouth wide open roaring.
Bottom-left: Cao Cao, pale face, thin pointed mustache and goatee, narrow scheming eyes, black official hat, a sly smirk.
Bottom-right: Lu Bu, fierce warrior with a headdress of two very long pheasant tail feathers that curve back over his head and stay inside the panel, red lacquered armor, arrogant sneer with his chin raised.
